mainEntity.name: What are the water and sewer connection requirements for an ADU in Alameda?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Alameda, water and sewer connection requirements for an ADU often involve assessing existing lines for capacity and ensuring compliance with Alameda Municipal Power (AMP) and Alameda Public Works standards. Depending on the ADU's size and intended use, new dedicated lines or an upgrade to existing service may be required. For Alameda residents, a key process clarity point is that the city's specific permitting and inspection processes will dictate whether a simple tie-in or a more complex upgrade, including potential impact fees, is necessary. Our team at Hometelligent Inc. is familiar with these local requirements.
